title: Correct flight time
description: Essential: Student must derive or state the correct time of flight as t = √(2h/g).

title: Correct final speed
description: Essential: Student must derive or state the correct final speed as v = √(v₀² + 2gh).

title: Vertical free-fall analysis
description: Important: Student must recognize that the vertical motion is independent free fall with initial vertical velocity zero.

title: Vector addition of velocities
description: Important: Student must correctly combine horizontal and vertical velocity components using Pythagorean theorem.

title: Horizontal motion constant
description: Optional: Student may note that horizontal velocity remains constant at v₀ throughout the motion.

title: Units consistency
description: Optional: Student may include correct units (s for time, m/s for speed) in final answers.

title: Incorrect time formula
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses time formula involving horizontal distance or inclined plane angle.

title: Velocity component confusion
description: Pitfall: Student adds velocities algebraically instead of vectorially, giving v = v₀ + √(2gh).

title: Sign error in kinematics
description: Pitfall: Student uses incorrect sign in vertical motion equation (e.g., h = -½gt² without proper sign handling).
